f917d7f9.measures: When riding on a wet road in rainy days, the motorcycle driver should try not to tilt the motorcycle, and need to tilt slightly when turning only. The throttle control should be steady to avoid rapid acceleration, especially on the zebra crossing, white lines, yellow lines and other markings on the road, as well as manhole covers and road expansion joints. The tires are very easy to slip, so the motorcycle must be very careful when riding.

00621cac.texts: a motorbike is out of control
00621cac.measures: Motorcycles should not drive over speed, and should slow down when encountering curves to prevent the vehicle from sideslipping. When driving in rainy days, the road surface is wet and slippery, and the friction resistance becomes smaller. Vehicles should control the speed, and the braking operation of them should be as soft as possible to avoid anti lock falling.
